label: r3c3
name: r2c1 with lr 2e-3
hypothesis: Double the learning rate to 0.002 on r2c1's recipe. Learning is limited by speed: training success was 0.30 at 25% of training and still rising at the end. Linear decay to 0 should reduce late instability, and the 0.2 clip limits the size of each policy step. Refuted if dev success is at or below 0.919, or if the learning curve shows collapse or plateaus lower.
last_analysis: Fixing the mirrored column mapping took dev success from 0 to 0.75. Updating more often helped next: 64 worlds scored 0.919 against 0.868 for 128. A learning rate of 0.002 gave the best, 0.926, within noise of 0.919 but with a faster early learning curve. Rollout length 8 and 2 PPO epochs each had one seed fail (0.30, 0.00), so they are unsafe for the 4-seed retrain. Gamma 0.99 gave a small, noise-level gain at 128 worlds and is untested on the best recipe. Bigger or slower heads lost because they get fewer samples (r1c3, r2c3). Greedy traces now fail mostly on ordering under overhangs. The head sees only 3x3-smoothed trunk features, which may blur the per-layer column information it needs to judge where a brick lands. Last round: two single changes to r3c3, plus their combination.
